filters.spaces: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = spaces.id AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.space_members: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = space_members.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.sources: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = sources.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.renditions: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = renditions.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.passages: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = passages.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.ingestion_runs: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = ingestion_runs.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.pages: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = pages.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.page_revisions: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = page_revisions.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.citations: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = citations.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.page_links: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = page_links.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.user_directory: user_directory.id = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members mine JOIN space_members other ON other.space = mine.space WHERE mine.account = :requester AND mine.active = 1 AND other.account = user_directory.id AND other.active = 1)
filters.publications: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = publications.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)
filters.audit_log: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_members m WHERE m.space = audit_log.space AND m.account = :requester AND m.active = 1)

pages.snapshotScopeWhere: publications.sequence = (SELECT max(p.sequence) FROM publications p WHERE p.space = publications.space)
